definitions.explanation: An outdoor extension of a building, typically with a roof, often used for drying laundry, keeping plants, or relaxing.

examples.japanese: ベランダで{洗濯物|せんたくもの}を{干|ほ}す。
examples.english: I hang the laundry to dry on the balcony.

examples.japanese: ベランダに{花|はな}を{飾|かざ}っている。
examples.english: I have flowers displayed on the balcony.

examples.japanese: ベランダから{夜景|やけい}が{見|み}える。
examples.english: You can see the night view from the balcony.

notes:
USAGE NOTES:
- In Japanese apartments, ベランダ is typically used for drying laundry and storage.
- May have a roof (unlike バルコニー which is typically uncovered).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ベランダに{出|で}る (to go out onto the balcony)
- ベランダで{洗濯物|せんたくもの}を{干|ほ}す (to dry laundry on the balcony)
- ベランダ{菜園|さいえん} (balcony garden)
